sections.heading: About
sections.text: [Backblaze B2](https://www.backblaze.com/cloud-storage) is enterprise-grade, S3 compatible storage used to store and serve data.

sections.heading: Use
sections.text: Backblaze is used by the digital production team to store and manage their archives of videos.

sections.heading: Access
sections.text: To request access to Backblaze, please open an [access request](/handbook/eta/corporate-it/end-user-services/access-requests/access-requests/). Backblaze is not a tool that provides user seats to each user. One account with one login is provided to users who need access to the UI. Please state your justification for needing access - it may or may not be denied as this tool is primarily for the digital production team due to the large amount of data they manage.
